Six Arrested in MP's Ratlam

Six individuals were arrested in Ratlam, Madhya Pradesh, and gold and silver ornaments worth approximately ₹5.5 crore were recovered. The recovery was made in connection with a trader robbery case. The exact circumstances of the robbery and the arrests were not detailed, but the value of the recovered items was reported to be around ₹5.5 crore by one source and ₹5.41 crore by another. The police action led to the apprehension of the six suspects. The case is reportedly related to a robbery involving a trader in Ratlam.
